name: El Capitán Trueno: La Espada del Toledano
summary:
Capitán Trueno and his inseparable friends, Goliath and Crispín, have to help Sigrid to recover La Espada del Toledano, symbol of power in the island of Thule. If they do not find the old sword in time, Sigrid's family will lose the control of Thule. Each of the protagonists will have to apply their best weapon in order to resolve the intrigue and follow the track of the sword from the coast of Granada to the icy Viking dungeons. Interrogating smart thieves, escaping from fierce herds of wolves, enrolling in a pirate ship, facing ruthless henchmen are some of the thousand and one adventures that our heroes will live to recover that old relic and presenting it in time in the centennial celebration of the Independence of Thule.

El Capitán Trueno: La Espada del Toledano is the second instalment of the exploits of Capitán Trueno in the world of graphic adventures, with more characters, more dialogues, more special effects, more animations and updated graphics.
